# Proposal: Richard Welsh, Edgeware R&D Q4 invoice 2 (Post paid)

**Version 1.1.2**
Removed the NSF to make clear the separation between the incentives of core work and curation (10% bonus).
Added the Spot rate to show the relative loss of earnings for quarterly post-paid.
﻿
**Version 1.1.1**
Separated the two invoices in the document leaving just invoice 2 detail 
Created a separate post to ensure easier organisation and discovery 

**Version 1.1** 
Corrected USD/GBP monthly exchange rate (used this tool) 
Added missing NSF on Invoice 2 
Added calculation for FX movement and risk with post-paid model 

**Version 1.0**
This invoice covers the first current period of work on Edgeware R&D and is aimed to be the last that is solely funded by Edgeware. 

-----------

## Overview of ongoing R&D over past 3 months 

The following work has been ongoing for the previous three months and follows the work done previously on network strategy. 

-- Work underway with establishing initial context and rationale for Network Publics. 

-- Evolving the concept of EDGverse sovereign identity that will be minted on Kabocha in the form of Seeds.

- [Twitter thread](https://twitter.com/kabochanetwork/status/1551883826305110016?s=20&t=j-oI_sSjFsa_ICm_47-bfA)
- [Main post](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6355-kabocha-seeds-outlining-the-evolving-concept-for-sovereign-identity-in-the-edgverse-and-beyond)

-- (Re) Introducing Edgeware to the Kusama community with the aim of establishing rationale for the introduction of Network Publics as a third category of parachain. 

-- Discussions with key members of the Kusama and Polkadot communities about the viability of the model. 

-- Discussion with members of Web3 Foundation about becoming active in Edgeware and Kabocha governance 

- [Hello Kusama, this is Edgeware ](https://kusama.polkassembly.io/post/1698)

-- Aim of unlocking Ku
